notes.title: Puppet Master Simulator
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I thought about it and decided that we need to reveal a few stories in front of the witch 4. And here is the Puppeteer game. This is a small story (I warn you right away :-)) But for that you can drag several girls from the world of people into the doll house. Well, find out what the puppeteer does when he is not chasing Chelsea)))

notes.title: Continuation of the game
notes.content:
Hello!

Friends, fans and haters too, I'm happy to announce the green light to continue the game Witch Halloween - Witch 2 Adventures in Hell.

The adventure begins right after leaving the dollhouse

Trapped in a surreal, diabolical realm, the demon of candlelight encounters Chelsea. He sets her free and gives her a chance to escape from hell. Will Chelsea find the way out? What destiny awaits her in this infernal place? The answers are up to you, and you alone.

The preliminary release date of the game is the second quarter of 2021

INRI

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1470310/_2/?beta=0

notes.title: UPDATE (MODS SKIN)
notes.content:
Chelsea lula Succubus 
A few people inspired me to modify the skins for Chelsea.
You can find the mod on the skin - Chelsea Succubus in the game folder
\ Witch Halloween \ Mods \ Skins \ Chelsea lula Succubus asse4 (file)
And put the replacement in the game folder \ Witch Halloween \ date
To return the standard Chelsea
\ Witch Halloween \ Mods \ Skins \ Chelsea Base asse4 (file)
And put the replacement in the game folder \ Witch Halloween \ date

Have a good game ːsteamhappyː
